advance_warning.message: Heldout onset warning evaluation. Brier score improves on the training-prevalence baseline.
advance_warning.target: Annotated anomaly-window onset in the next 6.0 hours, conditional on being outside a labelled window.

detection.label_definition: Published NAB anomaly windows from combined_windows.json

limitations: Provider timestamps lack timezone metadata; the UTC-formatted replay axis is nominal, not a verified wall-clock timezone.
Absent native-cadence timestamps are represented as null slots; no measurement is interpolated or fabricated.
Published NAB windows include tolerance around anomalies; lead time is relative to annotated window onset, not confirmed physical failure onset.
This evaluator reports its own metrics, not the official NAB score.
Archives may include later revisions. Observation time is not proof of original publication availability; retrospective results do not establish live prediction accuracy.
Models and normalization fit training observations only; IF thresholds and warning calibration use the separate calibration interval.
Anomaly normal-training selection uses the supplied training labels. Missing primary measurements are excluded from scoring, not treated as zero.
Numeric forecasts use at most 96 uniformly spaced heldout origins and no future actuals in recursive paths. These are retrospective archive tests.
Warning features use strictly earlier samples. Targets crossing split boundaries are purged; ongoing labelled windows are excluded from onset-warning metrics.
False-alert counts are sample counts at the native cadence, not independent incident counts. No aggregate cross-case accuracy is inferred.
These are retrospective point estimates on few events, not statistical proof of generalization or validated live advance-warning capability.

parameters.quantile_crossing_correction: interval encloses all three predicted quantiles
parameters.warning_threshold_selection: maximum calibration F1 over 201 probability quantiles
